## Argument

Scope. Work at (g,n)=(6,6), dim M_{6,6}=d=3*6-3+6=21. The exact target group is the open input W_{-16}H^{BM}_{16}(M_{6,6};Q); the target asserts the ordinary-degree-26 (Chow-codimension-13) contribution supported on the balanced CE locus Z is Tate.

### Proved steps

**Step 1 (Poincare reindexing).** For d=3g-3+n the open input W_{-16}H^{BM}_{16}(M_{g,n}) is identified by Poincare duality with W_{2d-16}H^{2d-16}(M_{g,n})(d). At (6,6), d=21 and 2d-16=26, so W_{-16}H^{BM}_{16}(M_{6,6};Q) ~= W_{26}H^{26}(M_{6,6};Q)(21). [Established fact, packet FND-0001, mechanically verified for all cases.]

**Step 2 (Tate-twist arithmetic).** Q(-13)(21)=Q(8), and the twist (21) shifts weight 26 to 26-42=-16. Thus the asserted ordinary type Q(-13) (weight 26) is equivalent to the open Borel-Moore type Q(8) (weight -16). [Mechanical: (-13)+21=8.]

**Step 3 (Borel-Moore/compact-support duality).** Borel-Moore homology is dual to compactly supported cohomology in the same degree with no extra Tate twist: W_{-16}H^{BM}_{16}(X;Q) ~ (Gr^W_{16}H^{16}_c(X;Q))^vee. The dual of Q(-8) is Q(8). Hence the open type Q(8) is equivalent to compact-support type Q(-8) in degree 16. [Established fact.]

**Step 4 (proper-pair localization).** For X=M_{6,6} smooth, Y=Mbar_{6,6} smooth proper, D=Y\X proper, the localization sequence is exact in MHS and the weight bounds give Gr^W_{16}H^{16}_c(M_{6,6};Q) ~= K:=ker(H^{16}(Mbar_{6,6};Q)->H^{16}(D;Q)) as a pure polarizable Hodge structure of weight 16. [Established fact.]

**Step 5 (semisimplicity).** Pure polarizable rational Hodge structures are semisimple, so every subobject of a finite direct sum of Q(-8) is again a finite direct sum of Q(-8). Therefore K (and hence the contribution supported on Z) is Tate of type Q(-8) in compact-support degree 16 -- equivalently Q(-13) in ordinary degree 26 -- if and only if K is spanned by Hodge (8,8)-classes. [Established fact.]

### Source-backed inputs (verified dependency)

**Step 6 (geometry of Z).** By the geometry-comparison dependency C66-GEO-COMP = ATT-0112, confirmed by REV-0157 and REV-0158: on geometric fibres with W~=W_4 oplus W_5, the residual CE obstruction is nonzero at Gamma iff O_C(Gamma)~=L:=W_5 tensor omega_C^{-1}, so (Z_ev)_red=I_red; the Abel-Jacobi incidence I is a Zariski-locally trivial P^2-bundle over the 15-dimensional balanced base, hence dim Z=17 and numerical codimension 21-17=4; deg(W_5)=16, deg(L)=6, chi(L)=1, and the f=4 obstruction (degree -4) vanishes while the f=5 obstruction (degree 0) carries everything. [Dependency artifact ATT-0112 + confirmations REV-0157, REV-0158; reflected in primary working-context established facts.]

### Gap (open frontier, not asserted)

**Step 7.** Steps 1-6 reduce the Tate-type claim to the algebraicity/Hodge-(8,8) property of the weight-16 kernel K supported on the closure of Z. This is equivalent to the Tate type of the mixed Hodge structure on a connected component of the finite etale S_6-ordering cover of the reduced-support locus. The primary working context lists this as an open frontier obligation: the induction isomorphism does not determine the Tate type of that component object. It is NOT proved here and is not assumed. This is the single remaining obligation; it matches the blocked route forbidding renaming the forgetful-map local system as Tate without proof.

### Conclusion

The contribution supported on Z is Tate of the exact target type Q(-13) (ordinary), Q(8) (open Borel-Moore), Q(-8) (compact-support) if and only if the Step-7 algebraicity obligation is discharged. This is the weakest sufficient reduction: it proves all bookkeeping and imports the verified geometry, and isolates exactly one open Hodge-theoretic gap.

### Blocked routes addressed

- vcd-only-vanishing: not used as the proof route; vcd(M_{6,5})=25<26 vanishing appears only as a background lemma in the working context, while the argument here rests on localization + semisimplicity + geometry of Z.
- forgetful-map-renaming-local-system-unknown: explicitly avoided; the local system / ordering-cover component is NOT asserted Tate, and its Tate type is recorded as the open gap.
- undecorated-cgp-top-weight-graph-complex: not used.
- point-count-without-degree-parity-separation: not used.

theorem_statement: Weakest sufficient Tate-type reduction for the ordinary-degree-26 (Chow-codimension-13) contribution supported on the balanced Casnati-Ekedahl evaluation-failure locus Z in M_{6,6}. (a) The open input is W_{-16}H^{BM}_{16}(M_{6,6};Q) canonically identified by Poincare duality with W_{26}H^{26}(M_{6,6};Q)(21); the asserted ordinary Tate type Q(-13) is equivalent, under the Poincare twist (21), to the open Borel-Moore type Q(8) of weight -16, and, by Borel-Moore/compact-support duality, to the compact-support type Q(-8) in degree 16. (b) For the smooth-proper pair (Mbar_{6,6}, D=Mbar_{6,6}\M_{6,6}), Gr^W_{16}H^{16}_c(M_{6,6};Q) is canonically K:=ker(H^{16}(Mbar_{6,6};Q)->H^{16}(D;Q)), a pure polarizable Hodge structure of weight 16; by semisimplicity of pure polarizable rational Hodge structures, the contribution supported on Z is Tate of the exact target type if and only if K is spanned by Hodge (8,8)-classes, equivalently by algebraic fundamental classes of codimension-8 cycles supported on the closure of Z. (c) By the verified geometry comparison C66-GEO-COMP (ATT-0112, confirmed by REV-0157 and REV-0158), Z_red equals the Abel-Jacobi incidence I, a Zariski-locally trivial P^2-bundle over the 15-dimensional balanced Hurwitz base, so dim Z=17 and its numerical codimension in M_{6,6} is 4; the residual CE obstruction is carried solely by the f=5 summand and is nonzero exactly when O_C(Gamma) is isomorphic to L=W_5 tensor omega_C^{-1}. The single undischarged obligation is to prove the classes in (b) are algebraic/Hodge, equivalently that the mixed Hodge structure on a connected component of the S_6-ordering cover of the reduced-support locus is Tate; this is recorded as the remaining gap, not asserted.
